purpose: silver_ourairports_runways is the cleaned runway-level table from the OurAirports bronze landing: one row per runway id, with text-encoded numeric ids cast to integers, 0/1 flags cast to booleans, integral measures cast to INTEGER, and Airbyte capture metadata removed. It feeds airport and runway analytics joined via airport_ref.
usage: Join to airport tables on airport_ref (integer). Treat lighted and closed as true booleans; filter closed = false to analyze active runways. Many geospatial and threshold columns are nullable (null rates between 0.22 and 0.90), so consumers must handle nulls explicitly rather than assume full coverage. Surface codes are raw source text and must be mapped by the consumer if grouped categories are needed.
limitations: Runway-end coordinates, elevations, and headings are missing for roughly 22-28% of rows, and displaced-threshold columns are about 88-90% null; no imputation was performed. surface carries 239 unnormalized free-text spellings. he_heading_deg_true has a max of 362.0, exceeding the 360-degree compass range, and le_ident/he_ident contain placeholder values like '.' and '-'; these anomalies are retained as-is for review.
